correctness.rationale: In the language of equality and STRICT B(a,b,c) only, the complete T_0 atomic diagram records equality and all oriented triples. Recursing T_(r+1)=(T_0,{T_r with each possible one-point extension}) exactly characterizes formulas of quantifier rank <=r, because first-order quantification observes existence not multiplicity. Independent reimplementation exhaustively enumerated all tuples of n=1..15, including repeats, and reproduced class counts [1,2,6,14] for ranks 1..4: at rank 4 types of 1..14 are distinct and types 14 and 15 agree. This finite range is not extrapolated: for all n>=15 the standard four-round EF interval-splitting strategy for pure linear orders (threshold 2^4-1=15) gives equivalence, and quantifier-free reduct to B preserves rank equivalence. Transitivity covers n>=14, so min(n,14) exactly classifies all n>=1. The independent finite checker cached 211372 complete assignment states. It says nothing about higher ranks, counting extensions, constants, or arbitrary betweenness structures.
